content.text: Why Microsoft 365 Intranet is a Smart Choice
Microsoft 365 SharePoint Online is a smart choice for your organization as it can increase productivity, streamline communication, and enhance collaboration among your fellow employees.
We will demonstrate how SharePoint Online can help you create a visually appealing and user-friendly intranet that employees will enjoy using.
We will showcase some of the best intranet sites created using Microsoft 365 and SharePoint Online, providing inspiration and ideas for your own intranet.
Links to Best Practices from Microsoft
We will provide links to best practices from Microsoft on how to create a successful and effective intranet using Microsoft 365 and SharePoint Online.

content.description: An isometric illustration showing multiple office workers at their desks using computers, all connected by glowing lines to a central cloud icon hovering over stacked server racks, symbolizing a centralized SharePoint Online network.

items.text:
**Microsoft 365 Integration**

M365 SharePoint Online seamlessly integrates with other Microsoft 365 tools, providing a unified experience for employees and streamlining workflows.

**Improved Security**

SharePoint Online provides enterprise-level security features, such as data encryption, access control, and multi-factor authentication, ensuring the safety and privacy of your organization's sensitive information.

**Collaboration**

SharePoint Online provides a collaborative environment where employees can work together on projects in real-time, share files, and communicate effectively.

content.description: Illustration of people collaborating around a large computer monitor displaying a SharePoint interface, surrounded by gears, a lightbulb, clouds, and paper airplanes.

content.text: SharePoint Online provides a powerful set of tools for team collaboration, including document management, version control, and co-authoring, which allows teams to work together more seamlessly and reduce the risk of errors or duplicated efforts.

content.description: A diagram showing various user avatars on desktop computers, laptops, and mobile devices connected via double-sided arrows to a central hub of Microsoft 365 icons, including SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and OneNote.

content.text: By having your intranet on Microsoft's 365 platform, you can easily integrate it with other tools such as Teams, OneDrive, and Outlook. This creates a seamless experience for users and helps ensure that information is up-to-date and accessible across the organization.

content.description: A 3D rendering showing a blue cloud with a large silver padlock in the center, resting on top of a row of computer server racks, set against a dark blue digital and high-tech background.

children.text: Multi-factor authentication is a security feature of Microsoft 365 that provides an extra layer of protection against unauthorized access to your organization's sensitive data.

Data loss prevention is a key security feature of Microsoft 365 that helps prevent sensitive data from being leaked or shared without authorization, protecting your organization from external threats.

content.description: A collage of various digital interface elements, including dashboards, charts, graphs, forms, and decorative icons arranged on a light blue background.

content.text: Branding is an essential factor to consider when designing an aesthetically pleasing intranet. Creating a brand guideline that includes a color palette, typography, and logo is important to create a cohesive look and feel for the intranet.

Navigation is another key feature of an aesthetically pleasing intranet. It should be easy to use and intuitive, allowing users to quickly find what they are looking for. Consistent navigation throughout the intranet creates a sense of familiarity for the user.

The layout of the intranet is also crucial to its aesthetics. A balanced design with appropriately sized text and images can create a visually appealing and easy-to-use intranet. White space can also be used to create a clean and modern look.

children.text: Branding is essential when creating an intranet as it helps employees identify with the organization and creates a sense of belonging. A well-branded intranet can promote employee engagement and productivity.

SharePoint Online provides a wide range of branding capabilities that can help you create a unique and beautiful intranet that reflects your organization's culture. These capabilities include themes, logos, color schemes, and fonts.

content.description: A wooden painter's palette with dabs of bright paint colors, surrounded by paint tubes and brushes on a white surface. In the center of the palette sits a 3D hexagonal SharePoint logo.
A 3D rendering of a person standing at the entrance of a dark maze with a bright white path leading straight through it.

children.text: User-centered design is vital when creating a user-friendly navigation. This involves understanding the needs of the end-users and designing the intranet navigation based on their requirements.
An intuitive navigation is easy to use and guides users to the information they need quickly. It should be organized with clear labels, consistent formatting, and easy-to-understand categories.

Visual hierarchy is essential for creating an effective navigation. It involves using design elements such as size, color, and typography to create a visual hierarchy that guides users to the most important information on the intranet.

content.text: Deliver on the promise for your links

content.description: A blueprint-style graphic featuring a 3D gear enclosing a white cloud with 'M365' written on it, resting on a blue technical drawing background. A pencil, paper clips, and a corner of a keyboard are also visible in the background.

content.text: The layout and design of an intranet is crucial for creating a visually appealing experience, which can lead to greater user engagement and productivity.

A functional layout is important for organizing content and making it easy for users to find what they need. SharePoint Online provides tools for creating a functional layout that meets the needs of your organization.

SharePoint Online offers a range of design options to create stunning intranet designs that are both visually appealing and functional. We will showcase examples of stunning intranet designs created using SharePoint Online.

content.description: Illustration of three black screens representing mobile responsiveness: a tablet, a computer monitor, and a smartphone.

content.text: Microsoft recommends that intranet sites be designed with mobile devices in mind. This includes using responsive design and optimizing for touchscreens. Modern SharePoint Online is equipped for mobile devices

Creating consistent navigation across your intranet sites can help users find the information they need more easily. Microsoft recommends using the same navigation menu and structure across all sites.

Customizing the branding of your intranet sites can help create a consistent look and feel that aligns with your organization's values and goals. Microsoft offers tools and guidance for customizing site themes and logos.
Microsoft Best Practice: Create a Clear Information Architecture

content.description: A complex digital network diagram overlaid on an office environment with business people. It features a central gear icon containing a dollar sign and various surrounding interconnected tech and business icons.

content.text: Identify Key Audiences and Their Needs

To create a clear information architecture, it is important to identify key audiences and their needs. This will help you organize your content in a way that is intuitive and easy to navigate for those who will be using it.

Creating a taxonomy is a crucial step in creating a clear information architecture. A taxonomy is a hierarchical structure that organizes your content into different categories and subcategories, making it easy for users to find what they are looking for.
Organize Content Based on User Scenarios

Organizing content based on user scenarios is an important best practice for creating a clear information architecture. This involves understanding how users will be interacting with your content and organizing it in a way that makes sense for their needs.
Microsoft Best Practice: Use Targeted Communication

content.description: A blue central virus-like sphere connected by white lines to multiple wooden blocks arranged in a circle, each block displaying a red user icon, set against a light blue background.

content.text: Effective communication is key to the success of any intranet. It helps to create a better user experience, improves engagement, and increases productivity.
Using targeted messaging is Microsoft's best practice for effective communication. It helps to deliver the right message to the right user, at the right time and in the right format.
Personalization in communication helps to create a more engaging and relevant experience for the user. It involves tailoring the message and the delivery to the user's needs and preferences.
Microsoft Best Practice: Focus on Employee Engagement

content.description: A 3D isometric illustration of a connected network graph with nodes featuring various icons such as user profiles, bar charts, checkmarks, and a cloud.

content.text: Creating a culture of participation is essential for employee engagement. This includes providing opportunities for employees to give feedback and suggestions, as well as recognizing and rewarding participation.
Gamification can be a powerful tool for engaging employees. This involves incorporating game elements, such as points, badges, and leaderboards, into the intranet to make it more interactive and fun.
Leveraging social networking features, such as chat, forums, and news feeds, can help create a sense of community and collaboration among employees.

content.text: Benefits of Intranet on M365 Platform
Having an intranet on Microsoft's 365 platform offers many benefits for your organization, including improved collaboration, integration with other Microsoft 365 tools, and improved security.

SharePoint Online is a powerful and versatile tool that allows you to create a visually stunning and user-friendly intranet that is tailored to your organization's needs and improves collaboration among team members.
